_comment: Self-contained demo config: two real stdio MCP servers this repo ships, so `uv run python demo.py` works on a fresh clone with nothing else installed and no network access. `--catalog` gives each a realistic roster, because routing a 4-tool catalog is below the size where a sieve pays for itself and would demo the product at its worst. Point TOOLSIEVE_CONFIG at your own servers for your own number. For an HTTP/SSE entry, see toolsieve.config.example.json.
